description: This file defines the UserLoginBlock class for Drupal, implementing a login form block with access control, form rendering, and placeholder URL handling.

classes.name: UserLoginBlock
classes.description: A Drupal block providing user login form with access control and dynamic URL placeholders.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the block with routing and form builder dependencies.

methods.name: blockAccess
methods.description: Determines access to the block based on user authentication and route.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the login form and related links, setting placeholders for form action URL.

methods.name: renderPlaceholderFormAction
methods.description: Static method generating a URL with destination query as a placeholder.

methods.name: trustedCallbacks
methods.description: Returns list of trusted callback functions for rendering.
